node.title: Re^2: setuid system() calls on Solaris 11
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I'm not sure if the replacement you showed would work on your shell due to the redirection. What I would try first is this:

system('/bin/sh', '-p', '-c', '-e', "/usr/bin/cp -f $version/$obj $dest 2> /dev/null" )==0 or die "system: \$?=$?";

I've added some error checking. Note that this suffers from potential security issues if those variables contain any unchecked user input! (And potential quoting issues.) I wrote more on that topic, and how to run external commands using modules, [id://1180578|here].
